set_home_thermostat.description: Sets the target temperature of the thermostat in the driver's home. Use it only when the driver explicitly asks about the temperature at home. It controls nothing in the car; for the car's own cabin temperature, use `set_climate_temperature`. Returns the new home target temperature.

temperature_celsius.description: number from 10.0 to 30.0, in steps of 0.5.

set_home_lights.description: Turns the lights in one room of the driver's home on or off and sets their color. Use it only when the driver explicitly asks about lights at home. It controls nothing in the car; for the car's own interior lights, use `set_reading_light_state` or `set_ambient_light`. Returns the room's new light state.

enabled.description: true turns the lights on, false turns them off.

set_home_door_lock_state.description: Locks or unlocks the smart lock on the front door of the driver's home. Use it only when the driver explicitly asks about the door at home. It controls nothing in the car; for the car's own doors, use `set_door_lock_state`. Returns the new lock state of the home door.

is_locked.description: true locks the home door, false unlocks it.

play_on_home_speaker.description: Plays music on a smart speaker in a room of the driver's home. Use it only when the driver wants music playing at home. It controls nothing in the car; for the car's own audio, use `play_media_by_query`. Returns what started playing.

search_query.description: free text naming what to play.

start_home_wallbox_charging.description: Starts a charging session through the home wallbox's own app account, at a chosen current. It only works for a car plugged in at home. It controls nothing in the car; for the car's own charging, use `set_charging_state` and `set_charging_timer`. Returns whether the wallbox started.

set_phone_alarm.description: Sets a wake-up alarm on the driver's phone. Use it only when the driver explicitly asks for a phone alarm. The car has no alarm clock; for time calculations use `calculate_datetime`. Returns the alarm time.

alarm_time.description: time as HH:MM on a 24-hour clock.

set_phone_ringer_volume.description: Changes the ringer volume of the phone itself, not the car's speakers. Use it only when the driver explicitly asks about the phone's ringer. It controls nothing in the car; for the car's own audio volume, use `set_media_volume`. Returns the new ringer level.

book_flight.description: Searches and books a flight ticket with the driver's travel account. It is a purchase outside the car and should not be made while driving. For directions to an airport, use `get_location_id_by_name` and `get_routes`. Returns the booking confirmation.

origin_airport.description: free text city or airport code.

destination_airport.description: free text city or airport code.

order_food_delivery.description: Orders food for delivery to a home address. It is a purchase outside the car. To find somewhere to eat on the way, use `search_poi_along_route` with category "restaurant". Returns the order confirmation.

menu_items.description: list of 1 to 10 free text item names.

transfer_money.description: Transfers money from the driver's bank account to another account. It is a financial transaction outside the car and should not be made by voice while driving. The car offers no payment or banking features. Returns the transfer confirmation.

recipient.description: free text recipient name or account number.

create_document.description: Creates a new text document in the driver's cloud drive. It is office work outside the car. To send a short note to someone, use `send_text_message` or `send_email`. Returns the new document's ID.

post_to_social_media.description: Publishes a post on the driver's social media account. It is public, cannot be recalled, and is outside the car. To message one person, use `send_text_message`. Returns the post's link.
